## Motivation

BU does not want MI308X to appear in the public web documentation.

## Details

One instance of mi308 found under `docs/`.

Remove mention of MI308X from release notes.

nodes.body:
@peterjunpark It looks good to me.
@Xiaoming-AMD Please help to merge this PR. It's a minor change in the docs,  so did not run CI GPU tests.

<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1331-a8ebf76d -->
### PR Pundit review
4 findings, 2 on diff lines below.

**Findings outside the diff lines**

- `tools/release_docs/announcements/v26.7.md:16`: 🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**
    The PR removes MI308X from the release notes, but the matching v26.7 announcement still describes the same feature (#1047) as 'DeepSeek-V4 extended to MI308X (CDNA3) ...'. The two release documents for the same release now disagree. If MI308X must not be published, the mention is still public through the announcement, so the removal is incomplete. The example directory linked from release-notes.md also still says MI308X: gfx942/README.md:1,4,32, README_full_4k_multinode.md:1,7,110,125, and the run_*.sh headers.
    **Evidence (verified by running it):** Ran grep -rni MI308 on head/ (excluding third_party). It found remaining hits in the announcement, the gfx942 example READMEs and scripts, examples/megatron/configs/MI355X/deepseek_v4_flash_4layer-BF16-sft.yaml:7,201, examples/megatron/guides/offline_tune/README.md:95, and tools/perf.
- `examples/megatron/models/deepseek-v4/gfx942/README.md:1`: 🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**
    Release-notes entry #1047 links users to the DeepSeek-V4 gfx942 work, and those user-facing docs and scripts still name MI308X throughout. The affected files are the gfx942 README.md, README_full_4k_multinode.md, run_128k_*.sh and other run_*.sh headers, run_v4_4layer_sft.sh, the MI355X configs deepseek_v4_flash_4layer-BF16-sft.yaml comments, and primus/backends/megatron/core/transformer/deepseek_v4_cp.py:13. The PR changes only one line. If the goal is to stop naming MI308X publicly, that is not enough. If these files are meant to keep the name, the PR should explain why only the release notes change.
    **Evidence (verified by running it):** grep -rn MI308 over head/ (excluding third_party) lists more than 15 remaining occurrences.

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

Changing 'MI308X/CDNA3' to just 'CDNA3' widens the validation claim. CDNA3/gfx942 also covers MI300A, MI300X and MI325X, which have different memory sizes. The note now implies DeepSeek-V4 128k context-parallel training works on all of them. However, the #1047 configs, scripts, READMEs (examples/megatron/models/deepseek-v4/gfx942/*) and deepseek_v4_cp.py:13 cite runs only on 8x MI308X with 192 GB per GPU. Readers on MI300X or MI325X may assume a tested configuration that was never run there. Suggested fixes: 'on gfx942 (CDNA3), validated on 8-GPU 192 GB nodes', 'validated on MI300-series', or keeping the specific SKU.

**Evidence (verified by running it):** grep for MI308 shows every gfx942 DeepSeek-V4 README and run script states MI308X as the test hardware (e.g. README_full_4k_multinode.md:125 '3 nodes x 8 MI308X (gfx942), 192 GB/GPU'; deepseek_v4_cp.py:13 'measured on 8x MI308X').

🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The new text 'it now trains on CDNA3 with context parallelism at 128k' names an architecture family but no product. This is inconsistent with the rest of the release notes, which name MI300X/MI325X/MI350X/MI355X, and with the reviewer convention of naming a gfx arch together with its products (e.g. gfx942 for MI300X/MI325X). The sentence also duplicates the heading's 'gfx942'. Consider 'trains on gfx942 (CDNA3)' or naming a supported product, without claiming MI300X/MI325X unless the feature was validated there.

**Evidence (verified by running it):** Read release-notes.md: other entries (lines 38, 53, 61, 68, 260) all name concrete MI products. KB item H0.3 records a reviewer suggesting the 'gfx942 for MI300X/MI325X' pairing.

files.patch:
@@ -231,7 +231,7 @@ capability.
 
 ##### New features
 
-- **DeepSeek-V4 on gfx942 at long context.** V4 upstream targeted gfx950 and in practice only ran at `seq_length=4096`; it now trains on MI308X/CDNA3 with context parallelism at 128k, full model ([#1047](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1047)).
+- **DeepSeek-V4 on gfx942 at long context.** V4 upstream targeted gfx950 and in practice only ran at `seq_length=4096`; it now trains on CDNA3 with context parallelism at 128k, full model ([#1047](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1047)).
 - **Packed-sequence (THD) SFT for DeepSeek-V4** — many samples per window delimited by `cu_seqlens`, with attention isolated so no query sees another sample; full model at 4k and 128k across three nodes ([#1062](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1062)).
 - **DLRM-v4 (TorchRec/HSTU) projection workload** with first-principles MI350X calibration ([#1059](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1059)).
 - **MLPerf Llama 3.1 8B launcher** and refreshed MI355X benchmark configs ([#1012](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/1012)).
